subject: The Annual Airflow Survey is Here!

messages.subject: The Annual Airflow Survey is Here!
messages.body:
Hey All,


It’s that time of year again! We’re reaching out to gather your valuable
feedback through the annual Airflow Survey, and we’d love to hear from you.

As key members of the Airflow community, your insights are crucial in
helping us understand how Airflow is being used in your day-to-day
operations and identifying areas for improvement. This is everyone’s
opportunity to directly influence the future of the project!

The survey takes about 7 minutes, and as a thank-you, we’re offering
participants a free AI Orchestration Fundamentals Certification Exam or DAG
Authoring Certification (valued at $150 each).

<
https://academy.astronomer.io/certification-exam-ai-orchestration-fundamentals
>

<https://academy.astronomer.io/certification-exam-dag-authoring-airflow-3>


Don’t miss out—help us shape the future of Airflow by sharing your thoughts
here: <https://astronomer.typeform.com/airflowsurvey26>

Best,
Briana Steel
